fields.name: syncId
fields.note: The unit's movement count, read as signed. A client applies the message where it is not less than the last the unit took; otherwise it drops it where the last less this, as a signed 32-bit number, is 1073741823 or less, and applies it where it is more. So a count passing from 2147483647 to -2147483648 is dropped.
